title: The Foreign Vocabulary of the Qur'ān
author: Arthur Jeffery
edition: Baroda: Oriental Institute, 1938 (Gaekwad's Oriental Series 79); reprints Lahore 1977, Leiden: Brill 2007
coverage: c. 275 words of possible non-Arabic origin, alphabetical by Arabic headword

target_coverage.terms: entries e.g. ṣalāt, zakāt, dīn, ʿālam/ʿālamīn, rabb?, raḥmān, sūra; Nişanyan's 'âlem' note cites Jeffery p. 209
